title: Banks Collected ₹7,086 Crore in Minimum Average Balance Penalties in FY26
summary: Private sector banks accounted for 70% of total minimum balance penalties collected.

blocks.content: Private sector banks accounted for 70% of total minimum balance penalties collected.

items: Penalty Breakdown: Private banks collected ₹4,948.71 crore (HDFC Bank top ₹1,798.14 cr; Axis Bank ₹1,081.33 cr); PSBs collected ₹2,137.92 crore (SBI top ₹477.27 cr).
PSB Exemption: 10 out of 12 PSBs have completely discontinued MAB penal charges.
BSBDA Accounts: Basic Savings Bank Deposit Accounts (PMJDY) exempt from minimum balance requirements.

blocks.summary: BSBDA (Basic Savings Bank Deposit Account) rules mandate zero minimum balance.
